challenges.name: Roundel portrait
challenges.description: Take a team photo with a roundel at this station. The station name must be legible.

challenges.name: High five a stranger
challenges.description: High five a stranger

challenges.name: Ask the time
challenges.description: Get a stranger to tell you the time.

challenges.name: Touch grass
challenges.description: Touch a living plant rooted in the ground.

challenges.name: Six-word review
challenges.description: Record a review of this station using exactly six words and send it to the opposing team.

challenges.name: Sit on a bench
challenges.description: Sit on a bench

challenges.name: Compliment a commuter
challenges.description: Give a stranger an actual compliment. They must acknowledge it.

challenges.name: Wave it off
challenges.description: Wave goodbye to a departing train until it is completely out of sight.

challenges.name: Pigeon metre
challenges.description: Get within one metre of a pigeon.

challenges.name: Bin five
challenges.description: Put five separate pieces of litter in a bin. You may not split litter into more pieces.

challenges.name: Seat census
challenges.description: Count every seat on one platform and declare the total.

challenges.name: Find every digit
challenges.description: On posters or signs, find every digit from 0 to 9. You may not include timetables or phone numbers.

challenges.name: Line colour hunt
challenges.description: Find a stranger wearing the colour of the line you arrived on, and tell them why you are pleased about it.

challenges.name: Station couplet
challenges.description: Write a rhyming couplet ending on this station's name and read it aloud to a stranger.

challenges.name: Five hellos
challenges.description: Greet five different strangers in five different languages.

challenges.name: Dated
challenges.description: Find the current year written somewhere.

challenges.name: Directions to here
challenges.description: Ask a stranger for directions to the station you alighted at. You must hear them out fully.

challenges.name: Count the steps
challenges.description: Count every step between a platform and the street, and declare the total.

challenges.name: Wrong hand
challenges.description: Every member writes this station's name with their non-dominant hand. A stranger must confirm all of them are legible.

challenges.name: Zebra conga
challenges.description: Cross a marked pedestrian crossing in single file, every member doing the same silly walk.

challenges.name: Cheapest thing
challenges.description: Buy the single cheapest item available in any shop.

challenges.name: Five in a row
challenges.description: Name five consecutive stations on the line you just left, from memory, in order. One error and you fail.

challenges.name: Statue mimic
challenges.description: Find a statue or sculpture and hold its pose for 60 seconds.

challenges.name: Vending roulette
challenges.description: From a vending machine, buy the item you would least like, then eat or drink it.

challenges.name: Upside down
challenges.description: Read a full newspaper paragraph aloud with the paper upside down. Any error and you fail.

challenges.name: Found roundel
challenges.description: Build a recognisable roundel out of objects you find, and photograph it.

challenges.name: Five high five
challenges.description: High five five different strangers. You may not ask them to high five you.

challenges.name: Small print
challenges.description: Read every word of one advertising poster aloud, including the small print.

challenges.name: Advert pose
challenges.description: Find an advert featuring a person and recreate their pose beside it.

challenges.name: Two ways out
challenges.description: Find both a Way Out sign and an Exit sign within this interchange, and photograph each.

challenges.name: Blue plaque
challenges.description: Find a blue plaque and read it aloud on camera.

challenges.name: Five routes
challenges.description: Photograph five different bus route numbers.

challenges.name: Pet a pet
challenges.description: Touch a pet with your hand. If the owner is present, you must ask permission.

challenges.name: Staff fact
challenges.description: Politely get a member of station staff to tell you one fact about this station. Do not approach anyone who is busy.

challenges.name: Gate count
challenges.description: Determine the total number of ticket barriers at your station. Make sure to get every entrance if there are multiple

challenges.name: Ten letters
challenges.description: Find shop or street names beginning with ten consecutive letters of the alphabet.

challenges.name: Squat squad
challenges.description: Every member does 30 full squats, thighs parallel to the ground. You may rest between squats.

challenges.name: Newspaper hat
challenges.description: Make a hat from a newspaper and wear it. If it leaves your head before you complete your next challenge, you fail.

challenges.name: Union Flag
challenges.description: Find a physical Union Jack or a non-digital pictorial representation of one. It may not have been made by you.

challenges.name: Advert audit
challenges.description: Photograph every advert on one platform and categorise them into three categories, each with at least 15% of them.

challenges.name: Foreign sign
challenges.description: Find text in a language other than English inside this station, and photograph it.

challenges.name: Forced perspective
challenges.description: Take a forced-perspective photo in which a teammate appears to be holding a roundel.

challenges.name: Sketch the view
challenges.description: Draw the view from a station entrance. Ask a stranger to score it out of ten, you must get seven or better. If they do not rate it high enough, you may retry with a new drawing and a new stranger.

challenges.name: Three chains
challenges.description: Photograph three different coffee shop chains on the same road.

challenges.name: Climb a tree
challenges.description: You must get at least two metres off the ground.

challenges.name: Hundred steps
challenges.description: Ascend 100 steps in total. No escalators.

challenges.name: Vox populi
challenges.description: Determine your favourite tube line. Ask five strangers what their favourite tube line is and why. If they agree with you, high five them. If they disagree, tell them why they're wrong.

challenges.name: Crossword (easy)
challenges.description: Solve five clues of a newspaper crossword. You may not look up any answers. A wrong answer fails the challenge.

challenges.name: Don't step on a crack
challenges.description: Walk 100 metres of pavement without stepping on a crack. If you step on one, start again.

challenges.name: Way out census
challenges.description: Count every 'Way Out' sign in this station and declare the total.

challenges.name: Age guess
challenges.description: Three strangers each guess one team member's age. The average must be within 1.5 years of the truth or you fail.

challenges.name: Alphabet map
challenges.description: Using only the tube map, find station names which between them contain every letter of the alphabet

challenges.name: Catch it
challenges.description: Throw a food item into your own mouth and catch it. The throw must peak above your head.

challenges.name: Silent purchase
challenges.description: Buy something without any team member speaking or writing a word.

challenges.name: Paper aeroplane 200m
challenges.description: Travel 200 metres in a straight line by throwing a paper aeroplane, walking to it, and throwing again.

challenges.name: Long and short
challenges.description: Using only the tube map, find the longest and the shortest station names by letter count.

challenges.name: Line ranking
challenges.description: Rank the lines serving this interchange by number of stations, from memory, then check. One error and you fail.

challenges.name: Colour wheel
challenges.description: Photograph objects matching six different tube line colours, one object per colour.

challenges.name: Water Pong
challenges.description: Throw a ball into a cup of water from at least 2 metres away. The cup and ball may be makeshift.

challenges.name: Rock paper scissors
challenges.description: Beat a stranger at rock paper scissors, best of thirteen.

challenges.name: Melt something
challenges.description: Heat a solid object at least 1cm across until it becomes liquid.

challenges.name: Escalator steps
challenges.description: Guess the number of visible steps on an escalator, then count them. Within 10% or you fail.

challenges.name: Star jumps
challenges.description: Every member does 50 star jumps, in unison.

challenges.name: Meal deal roulette
challenges.description: Roll a die to pick the shelf position of each component of a meal deal. Buy and eat what you get.

challenges.name: Shazam
challenges.description: Hum or sing a song until Shazam correctly identifies it. You may not play the recording.

challenges.name: Nickname
challenges.description: Get a stranger to invent a nickname for every team member. Change your Discord nickname to them and use them for each other for the rest of the game.

challenges.name: Exactly five pounds
challenges.description: Buy items totalling exactly five pounds.

challenges.name: One leg
challenges.description: Every member balances on one leg for three minutes. If a foot touches down, that member restarts.

challenges.name: Bottle flip
challenges.description: Land three bottle flips upright in a row.

challenges.name: Straight swap
challenges.description: Make a trade with a stranger. No money involved.

challenges.name: Something new
challenges.description: Every member eats something they have never eaten before.

challenges.name: Guess your elevation
challenges.description: Check the elevation of the starting point. Guess your current elevation to within 20%. You have one attempt. (Note: Use https://en-gb.topographic-map.com/map-kb57/England to determine elevation)

challenges.name: Eat Cake
challenges.description: Obtain some sort of cake and eat the whole thing. If you get a selection of multiple cakes, you must eat all of them.

challenges.name: Animal street
challenges.description: Find a street whose name contains an animal, and photograph the sign.

challenges.name: Feed some birds
challenges.description: Obtain bird-friendly food and get a wild bird to eat some of it.

challenges.name: Backwards block
challenges.description: Every member walks around a (city) block backwards.

challenges.name: Human sundial
challenges.description: Find north using a method involving shadows, then check with a compass. Within 20 degrees or you fail.

challenges.name: Grab a bargain
challenges.description: At any shop or market, buy something reduced by more than 50%.

challenges.name: Staring contest
challenges.description: Win a staring contest against a stranger.

challenges.name: Old timer
challenges.description: Pick a building you believe is at least a century old, then verify its age. If it is younger than 100, you fail.

challenges.name: Copy Wikipedia
challenges.description: Find a Wikipedia photograph of this area and retake it from the same position and angle.

challenges.name: Sing along
challenges.description: Find a song being played publicly and sing along to every word until it ends.

challenges.name: Unusual item
challenges.description: In any shop, find an item that cannot be ordered from Tesco online. It may not be own-brand.

challenges.name: Floor plan
challenges.description: Walk the whole station, then draw a map of it from memory.

challenges.name: Anagram station
challenges.description: Find a station name that anagrams into a real word or phrase, using every letter.

challenges.name: Five heads
challenges.description: Flip five heads or five tails in a row. You choose which.

challenges.name: Doubles thrice
challenges.description: Roll doubles three times in a row.

challenges.name: Price is right
challenges.description: One team member picks a shop item, the other guesses its price to within 10p. One attempt.

challenges.name: Solve a puzzle
challenges.description: Completely solve a puzzle found in any newspaper. You may not look up the answer.

challenges.name: Cry
challenges.description: Produce a single tear

challenges.name: Non-hat hat
challenges.description: Wear something on your head that was not made to be headgear. If it leaves your head before your next challenge is complete, you fail.

challenges.name: Hopscotch
challenges.description: Find or draw a hopscotch court of at least eight spaces and play a full round using a stone as a marker.

challenges.name: Homophones
challenges.description: Find two physical things whose common names are pronounced the same, and photograph both.

challenges.name: Five thank-yous
challenges.description: Get five different strangers to thank you verbally.

challenges.name: Life imitates art
challenges.description: Find a sign, photo or painting of an animal or plant, then find that species. Same family at minimum. Humans do not count.

challenges.name: Charades
challenges.description: One member acts out five station names. Teammates must guess all five.

challenges.name: Window memory
challenges.description: Memorise twenty items in a shop window, then recall all twenty facing away from it.

challenges.name: Soundscape
challenges.description: Record sixty seconds of station audio and identify ten distinct sounds in it.

challenges.name: Timetable maths
challenges.description: From a bus timetable, calculate the average interval between buses over 24 hours, and the average buses per hour.

challenges.name: Architecture critique
challenges.description: Go to a building over ten metres tall and record a video discussing five things you like about it and five improvements you would make.

challenges.name: Catch a critter
challenges.description: Catch an insect or bug in a container, name it, then release it unharmed.

challenges.name: Pay your respects
challenges.description: Visit a graveyard and place a flower on a grave that does not have one. Observe two minutes of silence, then leave and do not return.

challenges.name: Card school
challenges.description: One teammate should teach the others a card game they do not know, then play a full hand.

challenges.name: Piggyback
challenges.description: Carry a teammate 100 metres without their feet touching the ground. You may swap carriers.

challenges.name: Three-legged
challenges.description: Tie two members together at the ankle and run 100m in 30 seconds or less

challenges.name: Coin cup
challenges.description: Land five coins in a cup from two metres away. The cup may be makeshift.

challenges.name: Hop to it
challenges.description: Every member hops 100 metres on one foot. If the other foot touches down, that member restarts.

challenges.name: Height guess
challenges.description: Guess a stranger's height, then ask them their height. You must get it exactly right and in the same units.

challenges.name: Follow a jogger
challenges.description: Find a jogger and jog behind them until they turn a corner.

challenges.name: Tell the time
challenges.description: Start a timer and stop it at five minutes without looking at any clock or timed event. Within ten seconds or you fail.

challenges.name: Three laps
challenges.description: Make three laps of a block, each faster than the last.

challenges.name: Makeover
challenges.description: Change one item of clothing, your hairstyle and an accessory, then take at least five photos of the result.

challenges.name: Balancing act
challenges.description: Walk from one station entrance to another entrance with a leaf on your head. You may not attach it to your head or hair.

challenges.name: Blind taste
challenges.description: Buy assorted sweets. With eyes closed, randomly draw three, taste them, and name their flavours. You may practise. All three correct or you fail.

challenges.name: Sandwich assembly
challenges.description: Buy the components separately and build a sandwich. No pre-made sandwiches.

challenges.name: Five London things
challenges.description: Photograph a black cab, a red bus, a hire bike, a pigeon, and a London plane tree.

challenges.name: Picnic
challenges.description: Lay out a picnic on the ground and eat from it for five minutes.

challenges.name: Parkour
challenges.description: Make a parkour video at least thirty seconds long containing at least three stunts.

challenges.name: Half a kilometre
challenges.description: Close your eyes, spin, and point. Get as close as publicly accessible land allows to the point exactly 500 metres in that direction.

challenges.name: Question mode
challenges.description: One teammate speaks only in questions until your next challenge is complete. A statement fails the challenge.

challenges.name: Escalator marathon
challenges.description: Ride the same pair of escalators up and down ten times.

challenges.name: Wall sit
challenges.description: Every member holds a wall sit for three minutes. Does not need to be continuous. Legs at 90 degrees

challenges.name: Backwards phonetic
challenges.description: Every member recites the NATO phonetic alphabet in reverse. Any error fails the challenge.

challenges.name: Cover version
challenges.description: Rewrite the chorus of a popular song to be about this station and then perform it.

challenges.name: Know your teammate
challenges.description: One teammate should guess the number of photos on the other's phone. Within 30% or fail.

challenges.name: Sonnet
challenges.description: Write a fourteen-line sonnet about this station with a consistent rhyme scheme, and read it aloud.

challenges.name: Same year
challenges.description: Find the year this station opened, then find something nearby dated the same year.

challenges.name: Three trees
challenges.description: Find three streets named after three different trees.

challenges.name: Arm wrestle
challenges.description: Beat a stranger at arm wrestling.

challenges.name: Play Stations Panic
challenges.description: Complete a Stations Panic challenge from your current interchange. If your interchange is multiple stations, you may pick any

challenges.name: Cairn
challenges.description: Build a free-standing stack of seven stones that stays up for five seconds.

challenges.name: Build a tower
challenges.description: Build a free-standing tower at least one metre tall from any materials. At least five components, none taller than 40cm, standing for five seconds.

challenges.name: Traffic prediction
challenges.description: At a busy crossing, predict how many cars will pass in two minutes. Your answer must be at least ten and within 10%, or you fail.

challenges.name: Line diagram
challenges.description: Reproduce the full line diagram for the line you arrived on from memory, then check it.

challenges.name: Body letters
challenges.description: Photograph your team forming each letter of this station's name with your bodies, in order.

challenges.name: Charge your phone
challenges.description: Charge your phone (as usual, you may not use your own cable or powerbank)

challenges.name: Get a honk
challenges.description: Write a sign that elicits a honk from a passing driver. You should not step onto the road.

challenges.name: Every colour
challenges.description: Photograph every tube line colour represented somewhere inside this interchange.

challenges.name: Haiku contest
challenges.description: Every member writes a haiku about this station. Read them all to a stranger who will pick the winner, who must then thank the stranger in haiku.

challenges.name: Snake sketch
challenges.description: Draw your snake's entire body onto a blank map from memory. The referee checks it against the real one.

challenges.name: Tunnel distance
challenges.description: Estimate the distance to the next station along your line, then check. Within 15% or you fail.

challenges.name: Word ladder
challenges.description: Get from one station name to another by changing, inserting, or deleting one letter at a time. Every intermediate step must be a real word.

challenges.name: Geocache
challenges.description: Find and sign a physical geocache.

challenges.name: Five continents shop
challenges.description: In a single shop, find products originating from five different continents.

challenges.name: Order abroad
challenges.description: Order and receive food or drink speaking only a language no team member speaks natively.

challenges.name: Keepy-uppies
challenges.description: Make twenty consecutive keepy-uppies with a ball. The ball may be makeshift.

challenges.name: Basket
challenges.description: Find a publicly accessible basketball hoop and score.

challenges.name: Perimeter guess
challenges.description: Estimate the perimeter of a block without using any measuring instrument, then check. Within 20% or you fail.

challenges.name: Fifty digits
challenges.description: Learn and recite fifty digits of pi from memory.

challenges.name: Famous photo
challenges.description: Recreate a well-known photograph taken in London, in the right place, as closely as you can.

challenges.name: Documentary
challenges.description: Film a sixty-second documentary about this station with at least five shots, narration and a title card.

challenges.name: Eat, pray, love
challenges.description: Eat a snack, spend a minute inside a place of worship, then tell the opponents how much you respect them for thirty seconds. In that order.

challenges.name: Just a minute
challenges.description: Talk about this station for sixty seconds with no hesitation, repetition or deviation. A stranger judges, and may buzz you out.

challenges.name: Hundred press-ups
challenges.description: One hundred press-ups as a team total, in unbroken sets of at least ten.

challenges.name: Dinosaur
challenges.description: Using only the tube map, find the one station whose name shares no letters with the word 'dinosaur'. No cheating.

challenges.name: Line audit
challenges.description: Name every interchange on the Snake map served by the line you arrived on, then check. No errors

challenges.name: Stop-motion
challenges.description: Make a stop-motion animation of at least thirty frames.

challenges.name: Sudoku
challenges.description: Complete a newspaper sudoku with no errors. You may not look up the answer or cheat. A wrong grid fails the challenge.

challenges.name: Footfall
challenges.description: Count people entering this station over five minutes and extrapolate to TfL's published annual entries figure. Within 25% or you fail.

challenges.name: Top attraction
challenges.description: Determine the highest-ranked TripAdvisor attraction within two miles, get within ten metres of it, and give five reasons it is the best.

challenges.name: Wordless request
challenges.description: Ask a stranger for directions or to borrow an object without speaking or writing any words.

challenges.name: Cat
challenges.description: Find and photograph a cat.

challenges.name: Origami
challenges.description: Fold a paper crane from instructions. First attempt only.

challenges.name: Fifteen thank-yous
challenges.description: Get fifteen different strangers to thank you verbally. You may not ask them to.

challenges.name: Stand or walk
challenges.description: Record twenty strangers saying whether they stand or walk on escalators, and present the distribution with analysis.

challenges.name: Platform headcount
challenges.description: Guess the number of people on a platform, then count them. Within 10% or you fail.

challenges.name: Paper bridge
challenges.description: Build a paper bridge spanning 30cm between two objects that holds a phone for five seconds.

challenges.name: Introductions
challenges.description: Introduce two strangers who do not know each other. They must talk to each other for fifteen seconds.

challenges.name: The Knowledge
challenges.description: Get a black cab driver to explain the Knowledge on camera. Don't waste their time etc.

challenges.name: Applause
challenges.description: Get unprompted applause from five different strangers. Need not be five at the same time.

challenges.name: Instrument
challenges.description: Build an instrument from found materials and play a recognisable tune on it.

challenges.name: Life drawing
challenges.description: Get five strangers to each draw the same team member, and display the gallery.

challenges.name: Plank relay
challenges.description: Accumulate (4 × number of team members) minutes of plank as a team total.

challenges.name: Birthday card
challenges.description: Get ten strangers to sign a card for an opponent, each writing a different message.

challenges.name: Commercial memory
challenges.description: Memorise the names of fifteen different businesses around your station. When the train you want to get on to depart approaches (i.e. when you can see it), recite the names of all fifteen. No mistakes.

challenges.name: Full line recital
challenges.description: Recite every station on the line you arrived on from memory. You may practise. One error and you fail.

challenges.name: Skim a stone
challenges.description: Skim a stone with at least three bounces.

challenges.name: Marathon steps
challenges.description: Ascend 500 steps in total, consecutively or not. No escalators.

challenges.name: Balloon animal
challenges.description: Buy a balloon and make a balloon dog. Keep it with you for the rest of the day.

challenges.name: Human pyramid
challenges.description: Build a three-person pyramid including at least one stranger, and hold it for five seconds.

challenges.name: Front page
challenges.description: Write (with a pen and a sheet of A4 paper!) a newspaper front page about this JL:OX event. It should have at least three articles and one illustration. The A4 sheet should be completely full

challenges.name: Hundred burpees
challenges.description: Every member does one hundred burpees. You may rest between them.

challenges.name: House of cards
challenges.description: Build a four-storey house of cards that stands unsupported for ten seconds.

challenges.name: Handstand minute
challenges.description: Every member accumulates sixty seconds of handstand, in holds of at least five seconds each.

challenges.name: Mexican wave
challenges.description: Start a Mexican wave that at least eight strangers join.

challenges.name: Trade up
challenges.description: Starting from a paperclip, pen, or similar, make at least five successive trades with strangers, each for something more valuable, ending with something which verifiably costs more than £5

challenges.name: Five continents
challenges.description: Meet five strangers each born on a different continent. Confirm each and photograph them with permission.

challenges.name: Music video
challenges.description: Film a full sixty-second music video with choreography, three locations and one costume change.

challenges.name: Puzzling
challenges.description: Complete both the quick crossword and the sudoku from the same newspaper. No lookups. Any error fails the challenge.

challenges.name: Twenty-station quiz
challenges.description: One teammate will be quizzed: The rest of the team randomly generates (by whatever means, but it should be actually random with all outputs equal probability) ten pairs of two tube stations. The quizzing teammate must, for each pair, give the fastest route to travel between them. Check with Google Maps (8:30am Monday), it counts if their route is within three minutes of the given route.

challenges.name: Forwards and back
challenges.description: Memorise thirty digits randomly chosen 0-9, then recite them forwards and backwards. Any mistake is a failure.

challenges.name: Three links
challenges.description: Meet a stranger, get them to introduce you to another stranger, and repeat until you are three introductions deep.

challenges.name: Endurance busk
challenges.description: Perform continuously for fifteen minutes - off TfL property. Get at least one donation (Once they try to give you the money you should decline).

challenges.name: Blank map
challenges.description: Redraw the Snake map's lines and interchanges onto blank paper from memory. You are allowed one mistake on the lines (which lines exist) and five on the interchanges (which interchanges exist, and which lines serve which interchanges)

challenges.name: Full cube
challenges.description: Solve a Rubik's cube completely, having learned how during this challenge.

challenges.name: Fox
challenges.description: Photograph a fox (alive)

challenges.name: Benchmark
challenges.description: Find and photograph a cut Ordnance Survey benchmark on a wall or building.

challenges.name: Twenty signatures
challenges.description: Collect signatures from twenty strangers whose first names all begin with different letters.

challenges.name: Thirty thank-yous
challenges.description: Get thirty different strangers to thank you verbally. You may not ask them to.

challenges.name: Fifty words
challenges.description: Record fifty strangers each saying one word, then assemble a coherent sentence from the recordings.

challenges.name: Documentary feature
challenges.description: Film a five-minute documentary about this interchange with three interviewed strangers, titles and narration.

challenges.name: Sketch show
challenges.description: Write, rehearse and perform a two-minute sketch with speaking parts for two strangers, to an audience of at least three.

challenges.name: Dead reckoning
challenges.description: Randomly generate a direction, walk one kilometre with no map, then check your position. Within 100 metres or you fail.

challenges.name: Two hundred digits
challenges.description: Recite one hundred digits of pi from memory.

challenges.name: Deck order
challenges.description: Memorise the order of a shuffled deck of cards, then recite the whole deck correctly.

challenges.name: Feature animation
challenges.description: Make a three-minute stop-motion film of at least three hundred frames, with titles and sound.
